Subject: Score call: finalize OKR judgments + QBR narrative

Team —

Attached is v3 of the Q4 scoring workbook and the evidence bundle. I walked each objective on yesterday's scoring run; two items remain disputed and I want us to close them by EOD next Friday so comms and the QBR deck are stable. Quick summary: 

• OBJ-Infra-Costs: disputed between a 65 -> 70 hike (Laura proposed) vs 60 (ops baseline). The difference is treatment of caching rollout timing.
• OBJ-Optimize-Latency: dispute on whether the customer-facing latency improvements count as a full KR (Vivek flagged partial completion).

Ask: please review the highlighted tabs in Q4_OKR_scores_draft_v3.xlsx, drop short bullets inline, and mark any evidence gaps in the evidence_pack.zip. If we can't land these by Friday 5pm PT, propose a one-hour adjudication slot Tue Dec 8 10–11a PT.

For the QBR narrative, I need the 150–200 word handback paragraphs per objective (what we judged, rationale, customer impact) — Monica, can you draft the Infra and Latency paragraphs? Laura/Vivek please add your one-liners for callouts.

Attachments: Q4_OKR_scores_draft_v3.xlsx, evidence_pack.zip

Thanks,
Sean
Sean Gallagher

Quick note: I support Laura's move to 70 on OBJ-Infra-Costs — the production telemetry supports the uplift. On OBJ-Optimize-Latency, I still think the KR should be partial (50 -> 60) rather than full (75) because the client-facing percentile improvements only applied to subset of workload (real-time inference on GPU pool A).

If Monica and I can't reconcile the interpretation by Dec 8, I recommend we put an Exec Appeal on the table for the latency KR — it has downstream compensation/bonus impact and I'd rather not have ambiguity in the final ledger.

Thanks,

Subject: Re: Score call: finalize OKR judgments + QBR narrative

Thanks — drafting the handback paragraphs and attaching the narrative draft. See bullets below for what I plan to include in the QBR slide; will convert to 150–200 words per objective in the attached file.

OBJ-Infra-Costs (handback bullets):
• Judgement: scored 70 — caching rollout materially reduced per-token cost, measured 3% improvement vs baseline.
• Rationale: rollout completed on 11/22; documented in release notes and billing snapshot.
• Customer impact: lower unit cost improves gross margin on hosted API; call out two anchor customers (KiteMetrics, SIGMA pilot) that showed cost sensitivity.

OBJ-Optimize-Latency (handback bullets):
• Judgement: scored 60 (partial) — substantial improvements for real-time path but not across all traffic.
• Rationale: engineering delivered targeted optimization to GPU pool A; broader rollout delayed by infra gating work.
• Next steps: plan to include full rollout in Q1 roadmap and add a validation KR for 90th percentile across all pools.

I've attached QBR_narrative_draft.md with the full prose. I also flagged a minor evidence gap: we don't have a customer-facing benchmark doc for KiteMetrics' integration; Ada from KiteMetrics copied below can confirm the observed cost delta if we want to include it in the QBR appendix.

Attachments: QBR_narrative_draft.md

—Monica
Senior PM, Product Experience

Subject: Final: Q4 scores, handback paragraphs, and comms plan

Thanks all — pulling this thread to close. Below is the final adjudication and next steps; please treat as approved and ready for QBR packaging.

Final scores (selected):
• OBJ-Infra-Costs: 70 (approved) — evidence: caching_release_notes.pdf, infra_billing_snapshot_Nov22.log
• OBJ-Optimize-Latency: 60 (approved as partial) — note: Exec Appeal not accepted; we will document rationale and add the Q1 validation KR.

Decisions and rationale (short):
• We accept Laura's billing-based lift for Infra; it aligns with the production telemetry and customer signals.
• For Latency, Vivek's point about partial coverage is valid; full completion not met across pools. We will not re-open scoring for appeal — instead, include explicit remediation in the QBR and commit to a Q1 verification KR.

Comms and next steps:
1) Monica to finalize the 150–200 word handback paragraphs (due Tue Dec 14 EOD).
2) Sean/Laura to draft the exec-facing one-pager for the QBR (I'll assemble slides) and circulate to Sales/CS for customer callouts (Ada - thank you for being available to confirm KiteMetrics data).
3) Evidence pack finalization: Laura to add the ops mitigation note; Monica to include the KiteMetrics confirmation when available. Final package: Q4_OKR_scores_final_package.zip (attached).

If there are any objections, raise them in a reply by Dec 12 noon PT; otherwise I'll mark this thread as closed and push the final files to the drive link and QBR deck.

Attachments: Q4_OKR_scores_final_package.zip

Sean
VP, Product Ops
Redwood Inference
